name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.TLWE.antitone_chain_few_changes
title: An antitone chain of subspaces changes at most dim V times
statement: For an antitone family U_0 >= U_1 >= ... of subspaces of a finite-dimensional vector space V, the number of indices t < N with U_(t+1) != U_t is at most dim V, for every N. Applied to the spans of the decodable evaluation vectors of the positions >= t in a linear zero-test design, it shows that such a design has only polynomially many genuinely different positional hybrids, not the 2^128 that the hybrid-count barrier requires.
